quantization_verified_from_flatbuffer.method: scripts/inspect_tflite.py (tflite schema bindings) over each TFLite component
quantization_verified_from_flatbuffer.summary: 'int4' is mixed precision: INT4 per-channel for the large projections, INT8 per-channel for the rest; activations are quantized to int8 in-graph (QUANTIZE/DEQUANTIZE ops), which is why XNNPACK routes the INT4 FCs to the qs8_qc4w (static-quant) kernel config.

on_device_footprint.note: The XNNPACK weight cache (<model>.xnnpack_cache) is written on first init; its layout depends on the selected kernels and it is NOT keyed by ISA — loading a NEON-built cache with SME2 enabled aborts (see README 'Failed experiments').
